Namaste Business is a website that allows users to create e-commerce websites and native mobile apps for businesses.



Namaste Business is a commerce platform that provides solutions to all sizes of business.



Namaste Business i was founded in 2019 and was headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

about_short_description.short_description: Namaste Business is a website that allows users to create e-commerce websites and native mobile apps for businesses.

product.name: Namaste Commerce Platform
product.description: A platform to create e-commerce websites and native mobile apps for businesses of all sizes, supporting various business models.

product.name: Namaste Multi-vendor Marketplace
product.description: A solution to convert e-commerce stores into multi-vendor marketplaces where vendors manage their own storefronts.

product.name: Namaste Wholesale Commerce
product.description: A platform tailored for wholesalers and distributors to manage bulk orders, pricing, sales territories, and customer accounts.

product.name: Namaste Headless Commerce
product.description: A headless commerce solution that allows full customization of e-commerce sites for performance and user experience.

product.name: Namaste Developer Tools
product.description: SDK integration and custom CLI tools to build, deploy, and manage e-commerce applications.
